name: projects
description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new interviews for the finish line, the people and where the work stands; /projects:adopt adds only what an existing project is missing; board, pickup and close show and finish the work. A session-start line says where the folder's project stands — outcome, done-when progress, state — and, once a day elsewhere, which projects have been blocked for more than 14 days.
